lead: `int / int` answers a float in Novis, so `($size / 16) as int` throws at run time whenever the division is not exact.
body: A bench computing a piece size that way died with `cannot convert this value to int` on a frame whose length was odd, which reads as the member being broken rather than the arithmetic. Pick the divisor-free spelling in a proof — a fixed piece size with a `$take` clamp for the last one — rather than a cast that depends on the input's length.
